scope: Behavior-preserving code cleanup before optimization and visual/theme work
changes: Removed unused maintained-code imports, an unused render port and an unused symbol catalog port.
Reused the existing document command schema and document repository/render contracts instead of duplicating them in the configured print service.
Removed unreachable organization command dispatch and always-true editability flags from organization and doctrine editors; retained dirty, busy and validation guards.
Removed retired symbol-gallery and builder-library-list styles, preserving every remaining selector and declaration.
Added check:unused to lint; only unused diagnostics in unchanged hash-verified historical files are exempt.
Normalized whitespace in four existing development evidence JSON files.

verification.cssClassScan: No additional class-name candidates absent from source

checks: Assign saved ORBAT, click its subordinate, edit identity, role and personnel, and save the organization
ORBAT staff is read-only; direct editing, keyboard collapse, tab context, and unsaved edits share the same unit records
Selections replace one inspector, preserve other unit profiles, and the root edits the owning organization
Organization diagram is fixed against dragging and supports keyboard selection
Role add, duplicate, reorder and remove work in the dedicated editor; both views fit desktop and narrower layouts
Organization headquarters staff can be edited without assigning an ORBAT
Two organizations sharing the same ORBAT keep different unit identities and personnel
Unfinished subordinate edits receive a recovery copy and block organization switching; discard restores saved staff
Saved source changes update the diagram; removed personnel remain editable and matching replacement names never inherit them
Unassigning and reassigning keeps organization-owned personnel
Normal offline exit and reopen retain the assignment, structure and personnel without renderer errors
Doctrine create, edit, add/remove role and save through the editor
Organization creation and symbol assignment/removal save through the editor
Shared document commands generate and save a PDF from retained HTML with matching provenance
Normal offline exit/reopen retains organization, doctrine and document changes without renderer errors
